project_name: Equinox AI App Reputation Intelligence Platform

headings.instruction: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Use Manrope to give a premium, slightly technical but approachable feel. Always apply tracking-tight to headings.

body.instruction: Use Inter or IBM Plex Sans for body text to maintain maximum legibility in dense data views. Reduce font weight slightly on dark mode (use font-light or font-normal instead of medium for body).

labels.styles: text-[10px] sm:text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-zinc-500
labels.instruction: Use for overlines, small column headers, and tiny badges.

accents.instruction: Use electric blue as the primary interactive accent (buttons, active tabs, focus rings). Use gold strictly for AI-driven insights, premium features, and highlight metrics.

colors.instruction: Never use pure #000000 to prevent halation. Build hierarchy using background lightness shifts and 1px subtle borders instead of heavy shadows.

glassmorphism.instruction: Use SPARINGLY. Apply only to sticky headers, floating command menus, or critical modals.

shadows.instruction: Shadows are often invisible on dark surfaces. Use subtle inner shadows or glow effects for interactive states.
shadows.classes: shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.1)] for blue glow, or drop-shadow-md

gradients.instruction: Use subtle, low-opacity radial gradients behind key metrics or AI cards. Avoid harsh linear gradients.

borders_and_radius.instruction: Use sharp or slightly rounded corners for an enterprise feel. Avoid excessive rounding.
borders_and_radius.classes: rounded-lg or rounded-md. Avoid rounded-2xl or higher unless it's a pill badge.

layouts.architecture: Sidebar navigation (left) + Topbar (Global application selector) + Main Content Area. Ensure the sidebar is collapsible on smaller screens.
layouts.spacing: Use dense spacing for data tables (p-2, p-3) and generous spacing (p-6, p-8) for dashboard summary cards.
layouts.grids: High Density Grid (Bento Mode B). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for KPI cards. For complex views, use grid-cols-12 with varied spans to break monotony.
layouts.max_width: Use 100% width for enterprise dashboards, maybe max-w-[1600px] if needed, to utilize screen real estate.

cards.instruction: Cardless or subtle borders. Use bg-[#121214] with border-white/5. On hover, translate-y-[-2px] and slightly lighten border.

charts.instruction: Use Recharts. Ensure chart colors are desaturated to pass WCAG on dark backgrounds. Use blue, amber, emerald, rose. Do not invert light-mode palettes.

tables.instruction: High density. Subtle border-b border-white/5 on rows. Sticky headers with backdrop-blur. Use right-alignment for numbers.

buttons.instruction: Primary: Solid bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-500. Secondary: bg-white/5 text-zinc-300 hover:bg-white/10. AI Action: bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20.

icons.instruction: Use simple, recognizable icons. Stroke width 1.5 or 2.

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions, never 'all'. e.g., transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200 ease-out.
motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must change visually (slight background lighten or border highlight).
motion.loaders: Use skeleton loaders matching the exact shape of the content, pulsing subtly with bg-zinc-800/50.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over backgrounds meets at least 4.5:1 ratio. Muted text should still be readable (text-zinc-400 on #0A0A0B).
accessibility.focus: Use focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-500 focus-visible:outline-none for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-dashboard').

media.instruction: Use images strictly from the provided list. Do not use placeholder services. avatars for user/team profiles, app_icons for the global application selector, logos for competitor/integration contexts.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and background lightness shifts in dark mode.
Use glass-morphism effects sparingly and strategically (e.g., sticky headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations and colors relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠) for icons. Use proper SVG icons (Lucide React).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Subtle grain textures, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Use Sonner for toasts.
